overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that all selected tickers from the LLM judge have corresponding position-sizing outputs, but size_position may only output results for a subset of tickers (e.g., only MSFT), leaving other tickers without entries in the output.
why_it_breaks: The loop constructs claims citing position-sizing results for selected tickers (e.g., AAPL), but size_position may only produce output entries for a subset of those tickers (e.g., only MSFT). When the citation verifier checks these claims against the actual size_position output, it finds no AAPL entry, yet the verifier still keeps the claim because it does not validate that each cited ticker has a corresponding output entry. The claim passes verification erroneously and is shipped in the final report.
